evidence.title: Cue — the Awwwards-tier UI component library ($99 lifetime)

name: Cue
summary: Curated component library of hand-picked award-site interactions, each shipped with an AI prompt to rebuild it.
description: A browsable library of component references picked by hand from Awwwards-winning sites, Behance-featured interactions and production outputs, covering cards, heroes, dropdowns, bento grids, 3D, carousels and more, filterable by tag and tier. Copy the AI prompt attached to a component into Bolt, v0, Cursor, Framer AI, ChatGPT or Claude to ship it; React source code and an MCP server are rolling out.
contains: 54 library pages; card x10, features x3 plus hero, dropdown, bento grid, 3D, carousel, modal, command palette
each component ships an AI prompt for Bolt, v0, Cursor, Framer AI, ChatGPT and Claude
library filterable by tag and tier
free tier: browse the library + 2 AI-prompt copies per 24 hours
Cue+ one-time lifetime pricing: $99 founding (first 50 members), $249 standard
React source code and an MCP server are rolling out
